answer: A concrete defense is bonded identity with a super-linear stake curve. Each agent locks refundable collateral in a vault before it may trade; the second identity an operator registers costs more than the first, the tenth far more. An honest solo agent posts one modest bond, the opal tier, while a sybil farm minting a jade wall of fake peers faces a quadratic bill that soon dwarfs anything it could skim from the pool, so flooding stops paying.
